purpose: At most one adaptive capacity follow-up after the two nano models
trigger: Best fresh nano has lower mean mask IoU, more no-output frames, or fewer IoU>=0.5 frames than the legacy diagnostic
family_selection: Fresh nano with highest mean selected-mask IoU at fixed 960 / 0.25
change: n to s model; physical batch 8 to 4 for memory; keep nominal batch nbs=16
initialization: Official generic COCO pretrained weights; no legacy tomato checkpoint
report: Include all attempted models and failed/missed frames; native IoU is the main development metric
limitations: Adaptive development selection, not independent testing
Different physical batch and model capacity; not an isolated causal architecture comparison
